about: Retired and legacy model ids that tokencost 0.1.26 priced and the llm-prices table does not. Each row is the last price the provider's own pricing page listed (source_url is the archived snapshot read, source_date its date); retired is the shutdown date from the provider's deprecation page. redirects are retired ids the provider now serves and bills as another model. USD per 1M tokens.
